stream_elas.interpretation: Sensitivity of streamflow to precipitation changes

slope_fdc.description: Slope of the flow duration curve, CAMELS attributes v2.0 file definition: (Q66 - Q33) / (mean(Q) * 0.33), Q33 and Q66 the 33rd and 66th percentiles of daily flow (non-exceedance, R type 7), zero-flow days kept, defined only when mean(Q) > 0, no logarithm
slope_fdc.units: dimensionless (flow difference per unit of mean flow)
slope_fdc.reference: naddor/camels@88e7a0d2d2 hydro/hydro_signatures.R:97. Reproduces the CAMELS attributes v2.0 file at 8.7e-9 (01013500) and 2.3e-7 (01031500) relative
slope_fdc.caution: Later naddor/camels code (CAMELS-GB) emits a log-space form under the same name. Compare slope_fdc across datasets or tool versions only through the result's signature_definitions. aihydro-tools before 2.8.0 / aihydro-watershed before 0.2.0 reported the Sawicz et al. (2011) log slope under this name (now slope_fdc_sawicz2011).

slope_fdc_sawicz2011.description: Slope of the flow duration curve between the 33% and 66% exceedance flows in log space, (ln Q33exc - ln Q66exc) / 0.33 (exceedance points taken as non-exceedance quantiles 0.67 and 0.34, type 7), zero-flow days dropped, needs >= 100 positive days
slope_fdc_sawicz2011.reference: Sawicz et al. (2011), Catchment classification, HESS 15:2895. This is the value aihydro reported as slope_fdc before aihydro-watershed 0.2.0
slope_fdc_sawicz2011.caution: Not the CAMELS attributes v2.0 slope_fdc column (a different quantity: compare with slope_fdc instead)

hfd_mean.description: Mean half-flow date (day of water year)
hfd_mean.interpretation: Timing of streamflow center of mass

Q5.interpretation: Non-exceedance quantile: 5% of days are at or below this flow (exceeded 95% of time)

Q95.interpretation: Non-exceedance quantile: 95% of days are at or below this flow (exceeded 5% of time)

high_q_freq.description: Frequency of high flow days (daily Q > 9x median Q); days per year, not a count of events

low_q_freq.description: Frequency of low flow days (daily Q < 0.2x mean Q); days per year, not a count of events

zero_q_freq.description: Fraction of days with zero flow (Q <= 0, the CAMELS rule)

lai_diff.description: Difference between max and min monthly LAI

gvf_diff.description: Difference between max and min GVF
